skill_metric: geometric-mean probability of the answer tokens on the skill's search items (teacher forced). Plain non-benchmark text; not a benchmark score.
method: layer scores: loss increase on skill text when one layer is skipped, minus the same for general_text (nats). Blocks: shortest window with 60% of the positive score, chosen on the search half; check_mass and split_half_r come from the held-out half. Experts: router pick rate on skill text over general text, positive log ratio on both halves.
